lease_guards.conclusion: Retired ownership throws. A former background observation cannot be reinterpreted as foreground. The captured action compares task/scope/authorization/background object/display/generation before entering an effect.

explicit_foreground_entries.interpretation: Separate foreground mode and ordinary owner navigation still exist. The strict background test workflow must retain its background selection and must not press the Settings or root-manager buttons; their startActivity calls have no explicit display option.

limits: This audit covers issued tool routing, not a proof that arbitrary third-party app internals cannot open other windows.
The previously observed flight foreground changes retain their unknown cause; this static review does not erase that evidence.
